facts.statement: The fixed entry reads PNG bytes sequentially: it checks the signature, creates read structures, calls png_read_info and png_read_update_info, then calls png_start_read_image before looping over png_read_row.
On both supplied source versions, png_start_read_image calls png_read_start_row when PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear; when it is set, the function reports a duplicate call through png_app_error.

On both versions, png_read_start_row sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT after successfully claiming the IDAT inflate stream. Thus, if png_read_update_info has completed that initialization, the harness's later png_start_read_image call takes the duplicate-call branch.

facts.statement: The harness has a setjmp recovery path that cleans up and returns before the row loop if the duplicate-call report raises a libpng error. The supplied numbered evidence does not establish whether png_app_error warns or raises that error under this setup.

facts.statement: The supplied harness recipe disables STDIO, WARNING, and WRITE options in pnglibconf.dfa, then builds libpng16.la and links this fuzzer against the static library.
The complete fixed harness contains no explicit assertion about decoded row values. Its existing checks include the signature gate, creation failures, the IHDR result, and the image-size limit.
